notablePrerequisites:
Feldon does not have summoning sickness.
Opponents control at least four artifacts and/or enchantments.
description:
Activate Feldon by paying {2}{R} and tapping it, creating a token copy of Dockside Extortionist with haste.
The Dockside Extortionist token enters the battlefield, triggering itself and Coercive Recruiter.
Resolve the Dockside Extortionist trigger, creating at least four Treasure tokens.
Resolve the Coercive Recruiter trigger, untapping Feldon.
Activate three Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {2}{R}.
Repeat.
